description: For Persons including Companies required to furnish return under section 139(4A) or (4B) or (4C) or (4D) - mainly Charitable Trusts, Political Parties, Institutions, Colleges, and Hospitals claiming exemption.

fields.name: PAN & Organization Information
fields.description: Mandatory PAN, Trust registration details, sub-section under which return is filed.

fields.name: Nature of Activities (Part A-GEN)
fields.description: Select the primary activity: Charitable, Religious, Educational, Medical, Relief of Poor, or Political.

fields.name: Registration Details
fields.description: Details of registration under Section 12A/12AB/10(23C) or 80G approval number and date.

fields.name: Details of Settlor/Founders
fields.description: Information about the founders, trustees, or key management persons running the Trust/Institution.

fields.name: Balance Sheet (Part A-BS)
fields.description: Trust funds, corpus donations received, secured/unsecured loans, and details of investments (Section 11(5) modes).

fields.name: Receipts & Payments Account
fields.description: Gross receipts from voluntary contributions, fees, donations (corpus and general).

fields.name: Application of Income (Schedule J/I/K)
fields.description: Mandatory spending details — the trust must spend 85% of its income on its objectives to claim full exemption.

fields.name: Accumulation of Income (Form 10)
fields.description: Details of the 15% income allowed to be accumulated, or any deficit allowed to be carried forward.

fields.name: Voluntary Contributions (Schedule VC)
fields.description: Breakup of foreign contributions (FCRA), local donations, anonymous donations, and corpus funds.

fields.name: Audit Details (Part A-OA)
fields.description: Required details of the auditor filing Form 10B/10BB — compulsory if gross receipts exceed the basic exemption limit.

fields.name: Tax on Anonymous Donations (Section 115BBC)
fields.description: Tax calculation at maximum marginal rate for unreceipted anonymous cash donations exceeding the allowed limit.

fields.name: Final Tax & Verification (Part B-TTI)
fields.description: Tax on any taxable income and signature of the Managing Trustee, Secretary, or President.
